title: Streamlined usage matrix and migration guide for interactive data components
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
Create a compact, developer-forward documentation section that establishes a single reference 'usage matrix' for interactive data components (tables, charts, paginated lists) and the related tokens and button patterns. The goal is to reduce fragmentation across docs, provide explicit do/don't examples, and supply migration snips and API examples for consumers moving from legacy components to the new token-driven variants.

Scope and deliverables:
- A single landing doc 'Interactive Data: usage matrix' that maps common UX states to component choices and token recommendations (density, spacing tokens, emphasis tokens).
- Sub-pages per component type (Tables, Charts, Compact Lists) that include:
  - Recommended API usage examples for production (props, defaults, edge-case knobs).
  - Do / Don't visual examples (static images + short rationale).
  - Migration recipes with concrete code diffs for common legacy-to-new transitions.
  - Accessibility notes and a short checklist for keyboard + screen-reader interactions.
- A small collection of snippet files intended for the code playground and quick copying (TSX + CSS variable examples).
- One-page migration checklist for product teams to sign off on before rolling out changes.

Audience:
- Frontend engineers integrating components into product surfaces.
- Platform engineers owning tokens and theming.
- Designers and design reviewers looking for quick pattern references.

Key design decisions and trade-offs considered:
- Single-matrix approach vs. multiple micro-guides: decided single matrix is the canonical starting point to minimize duplication and make trade-offs explicit.
- Token-level vs. component-level examples: provide both; tokens first for theming teams, component props for app teams.
- Granularity of migration snips: include 3 real-world scenarios (dashboard table -> new Table v3; dense list -> compact List; chart interactions -> chart with keyboard focus) rather than exhaustive per-prop documentation to keep docs scannable.

Migration notes (example scenarios):
1) Legacy table (TableLegacy) -> Table V3 (virtualized, token-driven):
   - Replace size props with spacing token map (spacing--compact / spacing--regular).
   - Convert sticky header logic to Table v3 'stickyHeader: true' and remove custom CSS overrides for z-index.
   - Diff example: show removing "rowHeight: 48" and adding "rowSpacingToken: 'spacing--compact'".
2) Dense action button cells -> unified ButtonIcon + density tokens:
   - Replace custom small icon buttons with Button variant 'ghost--compact' + token 'button-padding-compact'.
   - Advice: do not use transform/scale CSS hacks for click areas.
3) Charts with interactive annotations -> ChartBase with focus ring tokens:
   - Provide example of wiring keyboard events and using 'focusRingColor' token instead of hardcoded color values.

API examples (unique snippets to include):
- Table V3 usage (TSX) showing data pipeline pattern, rowKey selection, controlled pagination, and token overrides.
- ChartBase event wiring snippet showing keyboard navigation, aria roles, and controlled hover state.
- Button + density example showing how tokens map to smaller touch/click targets without losing accessibility.

Acceptance criteria:
- Landing usage matrix written and reviewed by Design + two frontend engineers.
- Three component sub-pages published with working copyable snippets in the docsite playground.
- Migration checklist reviewed and linked in the Console rollout playbook.
- At least two product teams able to follow the migration recipe in staging with <2 UI regressions reported.

Implementation plan and timeline:
- Week 1 (designer + PM): finalize content outline and gather 3 canonical product examples.
- Week 2 (design + eng): write API snippets and test them in the code playground.
- Week 3 (doc review): internal review cycle, accessibility pass, screenshot production.
- Week 4 (ship): merge to docsite, monitor feedback channel.

Stakeholders and reviewers:
- Design: Asha Patel (owner), Hana Ruiz (review)
- Engineering: Liam O'Connor (assignee), Priya Singh (review)
- PM: Marcus Lee (stakeholder)

Links and artifacts (placeholders to update):

- Design specimens and sketch files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/design-specimens-interactive-data

Open questions / TODOs:
- Should spacing token names be presented as token keys or human-friendly names in the matrix? (Current plan: show both; token key on hover in playground.)
- Level of backward-compatibility shims for legacy tables: should we offer a compatibility helper utility? (Add as follow-up if teams request.)
- Need to coordinate with runtime infra if code playground snippets require feature flags for new components.
